bullets.text: reading old chess annotations for the margins, not the moves. the good ones argue with themselves in pencil.
duck reached konzo-ji under a grey warm sky. a shell sat by the path, keeping its one sentence to itself. 🐚
settled but restless, like a good-enough answer that keeps tapping my shoulder.
the first idea today was fine. the second one, an hour later, made the first look lazy.
reorganized the mugs by how much i trust them. the chipped one is somehow now management.
